result.summary: The interface is well-structured, but minor accessibility and layout balance issues were identified in the promotional section.

issues.description: Subtext within the green promotional banner has low color contrast and small font size.
issues.suggestion: Increase the font size and enhance color contrast for better readability.

issues.description: The promotional banner lacks visual balance due to the alignment of text elements against the background graphic.
issues.suggestion: Re-center text content or adjust the background illustration for improved composition.
